_comment: GXQL snippet library for the Explore IDE-completion palette. Served verbatim by GET /api/soql/templates. Every `soql` here MUST compile through guatx_core::soql::to_sql(&Schema::events()) — a daemon test (soql_templates_all_compile) asserts it, so an invalid template fails CI, never ships. keywords are for the client-side keyword search (FR + EN). Additive UX only; no gate, no schema.

templates.title: Échecs SSH (par IP source)
templates.soql: search source=sshd action=failure | stats count by src_ip | sort -count | head 20

templates.title: Top IP sources
templates.soql: search | stats count by src_ip | sort -count | head 20

templates.title: Port scan (par IP source)
templates.soql: search source=portscan | stats count by src_ip | sort -count | head 20

templates.title: Utilisation sudo (par utilisateur)
templates.soql: search source=sudo | stats count by user | sort -count | head 20

templates.title: Échecs d'authentification dans le temps
templates.soql: search category=auth action=failure | timechart span=1h count

templates.title: Blocages firewall (par IP source)
templates.soql: search category=firewall action=blocked | stats count by src_ip | sort -count | head 20

templates.title: Top catégories d'événements
templates.soql: search | stats count by category | sort -count

templates.title: Erreurs web (par URL)
templates.soql: search source=web | stats count by url | sort -count | head 20

templates.title: Bans (par IP source)
templates.soql: search category=ban | stats count by src_ip | sort -count | head 20

templates.title: Hôtes distincts par source
templates.soql: search | stats dc(host) by source | sort -dc
